welcome:
👋 Hello{name}! Welcome to Save Up!

I'm your personal savings assistant. Let's help you reach your financial goals! 💰
voice_error: ❌ Could not recognize the transaction. Please try again.
reminder_add_expense: 💸 Did you spend something today? Don't forget to log it in Save Up — small records make big insights!
reminder_add_income: 💰 Got paid or earned something? Log your income in Save Up and watch your savings grow!
reminder_check_balance: 📊 Quick balance check! Open Save Up and see how your finances are doing this month.
reminder_savings_tip: 🏦 Saving tip: even putting aside 10% of each income makes a huge difference over time. Are your savings on track?
reminder_daily_limit: 📅 Your daily budget is a superpower! Check your daily limit in Save Up and spend smarter today.
reminder_monthly_goal: 🎯 How close are you to your monthly savings goal? Open Save Up and check your progress!
reminder_track_habit: 🔁 Financial tracking is a habit, and habits compound! Log today's transactions in Save Up.
reminder_small_wins: 🌟 Every saved sum counts! Even a little saved is a step toward financial freedom. Keep going!
reminder_review_spending: 🔍 Take 2 minutes to review your spending this week. You might find surprising patterns!
reminder_future_self: ✨ Your future self will thank you for every smart financial decision you make today. Open Save Up!
voice_limit_reached: ⚠️ You have used all 5 daily AI voice requests. Come back tomorrow!
weekly_report_no_data: No transactions this week. Start tracking your finances!
recurring_reminder_body:
Tomorrow, {title} will be processed: {amount}

Make sure you have sufficient funds.
savings_milestone_50: 🎯 Halfway there! You've saved {amount} of your {goal} goal ({percentage}%)!
savings_milestone_75: 🔥 Almost there! {amount} of {goal} saved ({percentage}%)! Keep it up!
savings_milestone_100: 🎉 Goal reached! You've saved {amount}! Congratulations on your achievement!
savings_milestone_streak: 🔥 Savings streak: {days} days in a row! Keep the momentum going!
photo_receipt_error: ❌ Could not process the receipt photo. Please try again.
debt_list_empty: No active debts. You're all clear!
maintenance_mode: ⚠️ The bot is temporarily closed for maintenance. Please check back later.
